detection_logic: Same challan number appears in multiple transactions
recommended_action: Flag for manual verification; do not auto-accuse
Verify applicable policy, household size and units

detection_logic: Requested issue exceeds recorded stock before transaction
recommended_action: Block transaction until stock is reconciled

detection_logic: Large difference between allocation and offtake
recommended_action: Check reporting period, transit, reserves and reconciliation

detection_logic: Unusual frequency of manual stock adjustments
recommended_action: Review user, reason, approval and audit history
Verify transaction logs and approved authentication alternatives
